title: Fur Hat & Charcoal Scarf in the Snow
prompt: An original young woman sits on a snowbank in a brown fur-trimmed hat and a long charcoal wool scarf. She wears a tan embroidered shawl over a dark wool coat and holds white gloves in her lap. Her face is turned to the side, with hair blowing loose at her temple and a soft red lip. Bright winter sun, a palette of charcoal, camel, cream, and icy blue. Warm and adventurous, in the style of a winter travel editorial.
workingNotes:
- The layered textures of fur, wool, and embroidery define the look.
- Add 'soft sunlight on the snow' to strengthen the warm glow.
tryThis: Try this: Add soft sunlight on the snow.
